description: Flat metadata schema for record-level observations from a study assessing how culture conditions affect genomic stability and phenotype in iPSC lines derived from multiple donors.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record/observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or project.

donor_age_years.descr: Age of the donor at sample collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor; use controlled terms such as male, female, intersex, unknown.

donor_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or recorded ethnicity/race descriptor, if available; use controlled vocabulary when possible.

donor_health_status.descr: Relevant donor health status or disease category at time of tissue collection.

source_cell_type.descr: Original donor cell type used to generate the iPSC line, such as fibroblast, PBMC, CD34+ cell, or keratinocyte.

source_tissue.descr: Anatomical source tissue of the original cells, if known.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs, for example Sendai virus, episomal vectors, retroviral, or mRNA.

iPSC_line_id.descr: Unique identifier for the iPSC line.

clone_id.descr: Clone identifier within an iPSC line, if multiple clones were derived.

cell_line_origin_date.descr: Date when the iPSC line was established or first recorded.

cell_bank_identifier.descr: Repository or biobank identifier for the cell line, if applicable.

culture_condition_id.descr: Unique identifier for the specific culture condition applied to this record.

culture_medium.descr: Base culture medium used, such as mTeSR1, E8, or similar.

media_supplement_name.descr: Name of the media supplement or additive used in the culture condition.

media_supplement_concentration.descr: Concentration of the media supplement, with units specified in the accompanying protocol or controlled by study convention.

oxygen_tension_percent.descr: Culture oxygen concentration as percent O2, e.g., 20.0 for atmospheric oxygen or 5.0 for hypoxia.

matrix_coating.descr: Extracellular matrix or coating used for culture, such as Matrigel, vitronectin, or laminin.

passaging_method.descr: Passaging technique used, such as manual, enzymatic, EDTA, or dissociation reagent-based passaging.

passage_number.descr: Passage number at the time of the assay or observation.

passage_interval_days.descr: Number of days between passaging events, if recorded.

seeding_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Seeding density at the relevant culture step, in cells per cm^2.

culture_duration_days.descr: Duration under the stated culture condition before assay, in days.

confluency_percent.descr: Estimated confluency of the culture at sampling, as percent.

treatment_start_date.descr: Date the culture condition was initiated for this record, if applicable.

assay_date.descr: Date the genomic or phenotypic assay was performed.

assay_type.descr: Primary assay used for genomic stability assessment, such as SNP array, whole-genome sequencing, or both.

assay_platform.descr: Specific platform or instrument/model used for the assay.

assay_coverage_or_resolution.descr: Resolution or depth measure for the assay, such as SNP array probe density or WGS depth of coverage.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the technical replicate, if applicable.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the biological replicate, if applicable.

genomic_aberration_detected.descr: Whether any genomic aberration was detected in this record.

aberration_class.descr: Broad class of genomic aberration detected, such as SNV, indel, CNV, aneuploidy, LOH, structural variant, or none.

aberration_chromosome.descr: Chromosome on which the aberration was detected, if applicable.

aberration_start_position.descr: Genomic start coordinate of the aberration, in base pairs.

aberration_end_position.descr: Genomic end coordinate of the aberration, in base pairs.

aberration_size_bp.descr: Size of the aberration in base pairs.

aberration_copy_number_change.descr: Observed copy-number change relative to reference, if applicable; for example -1, 0, +1, +2.

aberration_variant_id.descr: Variant or call-set identifier assigned to the aberration.

aberration_gene_symbol.descr: Gene symbol overlapped or affected by the aberration, if known.

aberration_pathogenicity.descr: Interpretive classification of the aberration, such as benign, uncertain, likely pathogenic, or pathogenic.

genomic_integrity_flag.descr: Overall interpretation of genomic integrity for the record, such as stable, unstable, or indeterminate.

mosaicism_present.descr: Whether mosaicism was observed in the genomic call set.

phenotypic_change_observed.descr: Whether any phenotypic change was observed under the stated culture condition.

phenotype_category.descr: Broad category of observed phenotypic change, such as morphology, proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, senescence, or none.

phenotype_description.descr: Free-text description of the observed phenotype.

phenotype_severity.descr: Severity or magnitude of the phenotype, using a study-defined ordinal scale or controlled terms.

viability_percent.descr: Measured cell viability at sampling, as percent.

proliferation_rate_doublings_per_day.descr: Observed proliferation rate, in doublings per day.

apoptosis_rate_percent.descr: Observed apoptotic fraction or rate, as percent.

differentiation_marker_expression.descr: Summary of differentiation marker expression relevant to the phenotype, if measured.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the record passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_failure_reason.descr: Reason for QC failure, if qc_passed is false.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record.
